EX-99.1 2 tm2627620d1_ex99-1.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Rezolute Announces Completion of Enrollment in Phase 3 upLIFT Study of Ersodetug in Tumor Hyperinsulinism Topline results expected mid-December 2026 REDWOOD CITY, Calif., October 14, 2026 – Rezolute, Inc.

(Nasdaq: RZLT) (Rezolute or Company), a late-stage ultra-rare disease company focused on treating refractory hypoglycemia caused by any form of hyperinsulinism (HI), today announced that the open-label Phase 3 study of ersodetug in tumor HI (upLIFT) is now fully enrolled and topline data are expected mid-December 2026.

“Now that we have a path forward for congenital hyperinsulinism, we look forward to announcing topline data from upLIFT and to the extent the study outcomes are favorable, the potential to advance both indications in 2027.
These forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, the potential efficacy of ersodetug in treating hypoglycemia as well as our ability to announce upLIFT topline results this year.
